title: Delivering Sustainable Value through Responsible Operations
summary: Watch Delivering Sustainable Value through Responsible Operations and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_markdown:
Strong communities are built through meaningful partnerships, engaged employees and long-term investment.


In our 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, we highlight the progress we're making across our business, including:


• 98% of employees are proud to work at Brixmor
• 98% of national tenants would recommend Brixmor
• 3,400+ volunteer hours contributed by employees in 2025
• 20,000+ meals provided to local communities
• 56% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions since 2018
• More than 500 EV charging stations deployed


These results reflect the dedication of our teams and our commitment to creating value for stakeholders while strengthening the communities we serve.
